rows.organisme: Ordre National des Architectes — Conseil National de l'Ordre des Architectes
rows.notes: Headcount = the 2024 CNOA electorate: 2,685 registrants in the private sector + 214 in the public sector (press citing the order). Law no. 016-89 (promulgated 1993). A “Tableau de l’Ordre” page exists on cnoa.ma but is rendered in JavaScript; the portal is members-only. Higher figures (~6,000) circulate that include those not on the register and civil servants.

rows.organisme: Conseil National de l'Ordre des Architectes
rows.notes: Legislative decree no. 94-07 of 18 May 1994, amended by law no. 04-06 (texts on cnoa.dz). The national register is NOT published online. The local wilaya councils used to publish lists, but their sites are dead (Mostaganem listed ~168 approved architects according to a cached copy). No sourced national headcount (fr+ar). UIA membership formalised at the Copenhagen congress, July 2023. The order is in recurrent crisis (a former president convicted, 2023).

rows.organisme: Ordre des Architectes de Tunisie
rows.notes: Law no. 74-46 of 22 May 1974 (“no one may bear the title or practise without being entered on the register”). Complete 2025 register in PDF, direct count: 2,118 in private practice + 63 others + 482 salaried in the private sector = 2,663 names. TRAP: the TLS certificate of oat.tn is broken (incomplete chain). The press diverges: “more than 3,000” (2024), “6,267” (Tuniscope, not corroborated). The 2012-2023 registers are also online. Direct count from the PDF on 5 August 2026: exactly 2,663, continuity by section — 2,118 in private practice, 482 salaried in the private sector, 51 public-sector employees, 12 teaching and research academics (the modes of practice under art. 10, as at 31 December 2024).

rows.organisme: General Union of Engineering Professions (النقابة العامة للمهن الهندسية)
rows.notes: No separate professional order: registration goes through the engineering professions union (regulated elections in December 2024). The Libyan Institute of Architects represents the profession at the UIA. No register and no headcount published (ar+fr). Fragmented situation post-2011.

rows.organisme: Ordre Mauritanien des Architectes (ambiguous status: association/order)
rows.notes: The press refers variously to an “association de l’Ordre Mauritanien des Architectes” (2017) and to an “Ordre des Architectes” (Financial Afrik, 2024). No law establishing an order, no register and no headcount found. Absent from the UIA. A national school of architecture is planned with Moroccan support (2026).

rows.organisme: Ordre des Architectes du Sénégal
rows.notes: “No one may practise unless entered on the register” (ODAS website). Framework: laws no. 78-43 and no. 78-44 of 6 July 1978 (to be confirmed in the Journal officiel). The website displays “282 members” (2026); the PDF “Tableau ODAS 2025” (January 2025) has ~231 lines. Online directory. Press, May 2024: ~260 registrants, 1 architect per ~500,000 inhabitants. Direct count from the PDF “Tableau ODAS 2025” (January 2025 edition) on 5 August 2026: 189 architects on the register (168 in category A, private practice; 5 in category C, civil servants; 10 in category R.A, UEMOA reception; 6 honorary) + 25 trainees (category D) + firms (category B). The gap with the “282 members” on the website (2026) remains unexplained — a more recent edition of the register is likely.

rows.organisme: Ordre des Architectes du Mali
rows.notes: Established by law no. 89-17/AN-RM of 1 March 1989; framework reformed in 2025 to align with UEMOA directive no. 07/2005 (free movement of architects). Compulsory registration attested by the ESIAU litigation. No official website and no register online (a Facebook presence); no sourced headcount. UIA section.

rows.organisme: Ordre des Architectes du Burkina Faso
rows.notes: Active order: swearing-in ceremonies (18 admitted in 2016, 35 in 2021), a “Semaine de l’Architecte” (7 editions), president Ada Yaya Bocoum. A preliminary draft of a new law was undergoing validation (August 2024) — no law in force found, hence the obligations left null. The architectes.bf site is dead (DNS); no register and no headcount. Member of the Conférence des ordres UEMOA.

rows.organisme: Ordre National des Architectes du Niger
rows.notes: Active order: entry on the register + a 24-month traineeship + an oath before the Cour d’État (17 newly sworn in on 28 June 2024, Le Sahel). Founding instrument not found; no headcount and no register online. Absent from the UIA. ARCHIMAT trade fair (2025).

rows.organisme: Ordre des Architectes de Côte d'Ivoire — Conseil National de l'Ordre
rows.notes: Law no. 2018-868 of 19 November 2018 (art. 8: title and practice reserved to those on the register — verified in the PDF). Half-yearly register circulated as a PDF (press copy verified; the official site oarchitectes.ci is alive). Two sections under a single continuous numbering: architects approved for private practice, then civil servants, salaried architects and consultants. TRAPS: oarchitectes.ci contains injected spam (casino); the official online directory is down (Supabase quota exceeded, error 402 observed). President: Joseph Amon (re-elected February 2025). Confirmed by direct count on 5 August 2026 (the poster read in full as rendered): exactly 239 = 151 approved architects in private practice + 88 civil servants/salaried architects/consultants — breakdown obtained.

rows.organisme: Ordre National des Architectes du Togo
rows.notes: The Order’s register as at 31 March 2026, unveiled on 29 April 2026: 168 architects (143 m / 25 f) + 68 practices (the official portal headlines “167” — a discrepancy of one). 2024: 126 architects + 58 practices. The full register can be downloaded from onat.tg, but as a JPEG IMAGE, not a PDF. Decree no. 94-117/PMRT (code of professional conduct). UIA membership in July 2023 (Copenhagen). President of the Conseil supérieur: Péyébinesso Limazie. CONFIRMED 5 August 2026 by full visual transcription of the poster (3 agents, overlapping bands, zero name conflicts): exactly 168 (163 in private practice + 5 civil servants, numbers 005-247 with 75 gaps) — the portal’s “167” is now settled; 68 practices confirmed + 9 trainees in the corpus annexes; oath years captured (cohorts 1996-2025).

rows.organisme: Ordre National des Architectes et des Urbanistes du Bénin (formerly ONAB)
rows.notes: “Tableau de l’Ordre 2025 arrêté au 31 décembre 2024” (PDF verified): institution created by decree no. 83-388 of 1 November 1983. Count: full members no. 001 to 244 (sworn and authorised) + trainees no. 245 to 264. Online directory (onaub.com/annuaire). TRAP: the former site onabenin.org is dead but still indexed; ONAB renamed ONAUB (town planners brought in). Press 2022: 215→226 members — consistent with 244 at the end of 2024. Direct count from the register as at 31 December 2024 (official PDF) on 5 August 2026: 159 architects + 5 town planners (the order covers both professions) + 18 trainees = 182 persons; the earlier “244” is not found in the document — the historical numbering runs up to 264 with 84 numbers struck off/deceased not listed (a stock probably never cleared). A second count using the “Serment :” entries agrees.

rows.organisme: Ordre National des Architectes de Guinée (Chambre Nationale des Architectes at the UIA)
rows.notes: President: Boubacar Bah (Guineenews 2020-2026). Framework: the 1985 “code de l’Architecture” still in force, judged “anachronistic”; the new code tabled around 2010 was never approved — hence the obligations left null despite the existence of “approved practices”. No official website, register or headcount.

rows.organisme: No body identified
rows.notes: No order and no association identified (pt+fr). No UIA member. Architects trained in Portugal/Senegal/Brazil.

rows.organisme: Ordre National des Architectes du Cameroun
rows.notes: Law no. 75/12 of 8 December 1975 (the first professional order in Cameroon; first registrant on 2 April 1962). Public, paginated online register: counters in August 2026 = 829 registrants since creation, 502 authorised to practise, 375 trainees. Press coverage of the fiftieth anniversary (2025): 663 registrants, of whom 419 in practice, ~14.5% women, 81 practices. No official export. Beware the multiple sites: onac-noca.org (official), onac-noca.com, onac18.africa.

rows.organisme: Ordre Gabonais des Architectes (Conseil supérieur)
rows.notes: Active order under ministerial supervision: general meeting on 23 November 2024, revision of the internal rules, election of the Conseil supérieur scheduled for February 2025; president elected: Erichk Mauro. Founding instrument not found; no official website, register or headcount — coverage by the press (Gabonreview).

rows.organisme: Ordre des Architectes du Congo
rows.notes: Active order: forum in Brazzaville (November 2022), president Antoine Beli Bokolodjoue, general meeting of the federation of francophone architects of Africa. Legal basis, register and headcount not found; no official website.

rows.organisme: Ordre National des Architectes de la RDC
rows.notes: Law no. 18/034 of 13 December 2018 (practice of the profession). Online directory with a public search engine (onadrc.com); a second official site architectes-rdc.cd — a past battle over legitimacy (contested elections in 2021; current president: Fiyou Ndondoboni Monkoso, 2025). Approval numbers observed up to ~0585; no total headcount published. Hosted the 14th congress of the Union des Architectes d’Afrique (Kinshasa 2025).

rows.organisme: Ordre National des Architectes du Tchad
rows.notes: Created in 2012 by decree; art. 7: title and practice reserved to those on the register (press conference of 17 May 2025). “More than 150 members”, of whom 6 women (38 at the time of creation). The 2025 register was presented publicly but not published online. President: Senoussi Ahmat Senoussi (re-elected January 2026). UIA membership announced in 2021. An architecture bill is under consideration (2024).

rows.organisme: No body identified
rows.notes: No order and no association identified (the local press cites no professional body). No UIA member.

rows.organisme: Ordre des Architectes de Madagascar
rows.notes: The order exists and is active: president Fara Rahoeliarivahy (2025); public advocacy; plan for a national school of architecture (2025, with Morocco). Legal basis, official website (architectes.mg: dead DNS), register and headcount not found.

rows.organisme: No body identified
rows.notes: No order and no association identified. No UIA member.

rows.organisme: No body identified
rows.notes: No order and no association identified. No UIA member.

rows.organisme: Association Burundaise des Architectes (no approved professional order)
rows.notes: No professional order: Abarchi (campaigning since 1980) was still seeking its official approval in 2013 — “anyone can claim to practise” (Iwacu, 17 June 2013). No creation of an order traced since; the regulation requiring plans drawn by architects “was never formalised”. No UIA member.

rows.organisme: Rwanda Institute of Architects (with its Board of Registration)
rows.notes: Law no. 26/2012, REPLACED by law no. 023/2025 of 1 September 2025, now being implemented (notice of January 2026: annual licence compulsory, 2026 list of “eligible architects”). “Over 200 members” (ria.rw — a lower bound). Public directories by category with a 2025-2026 licence-holder filter, rendered in JavaScript (not countable without a browser). The IER covers engineers.
